Priya: Quick PR to adjust audit-export wording and add a tiny CLI+SDK example: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/751
Noah: Nice. Legal asked to avoid absolute retention phrases. Use 'default retention period (for example, 90 days)' and mention contractual overrides.
Priya: Updated to: 'Default retention periods are guidance; enforceable retention is determined by customer contract, compliance obligations, and applicable law. Dedicated/Private customers may override via admin controls.'
Legal: LGTM. Add a short note that pseudonymization/redaction tools are provided but not a guarantee; customers with strict needs should use Dedicated with tenant-level controls.
docs-bot: link-checker: found broken internal URL in docs/export-playbook.md -> 404
Noah: Replaced with https://docs.redwood.com/export-playbook#guidelines and added a minimal CLI export example showing pagination and redact flag: `redwood export --tenant acme --page-size 500 --redact true`
Priya: Also added a 3-line Node streaming snippet and a one-line pseudonymize helper. Merged after tiny punctuation nit from Legal.
Legal: Approved.
Priya: Merged to main; docs CI passed. Closing thread.
docs-bot: deploy-notice: docs.main build 1462 succeeded
